title: Rollout safety diff dialog & compact cost summary — visual polish + QA
creator: Maya Chen
description: Purpose: Final visual polish, accessibility pass, and QA handoff for a compact cost summary overlay shown in the rollout flow and a new 'safety diff' dialog that surfaces what will change when a rollout toggles variants or triggers a fallback. Scope: high-fidelity screens, interaction specs, microcopy for safety states, and a lightweight prototype for engineering & QA. Constraints: must be parity with existing rollout metrics, fit within the compact header area at narrow widths, and not add an extra network call (engineers requested using existing rollout payload).
design_decisions: Use a two-column diff layout on wide screens and stacked single-column on <720px to preserve scanability.
Emphasize delta numbers (tokens and estimated cost) with a left-aligned compact metric chip; color tokens green/red for increase/decrease with redundant chevrons for color-blind accessibility.
Compact cost summary is anchored to the rollout header as a dismissible overlay — persists per-session and collapses to an icon to keep header height stable.
Safety diff shows three buckets: 'Config diffs', 'Model variant changes', and 'Estimated unit cost impact' with inline links to variant docs and a lightweight tooltip for quantization details.
Microcopy: explicit confirmation copy for high-cost increases and fallback behavior; adopt 'Estimated' prefix for cost numbers to avoid guarantees.
Animations: use 160ms ease for overlay open/close and 120ms for row highlight to feel responsive without distracting during fast iterative rollouts.
stakeholder_feedback: PM (Talia R.): Prefer clearer escalation path — add an 'if latency improves' callout and an option to notify infra channel (linked to ENG-3491).
Eng (Karan P.): Avoid additional API calls — design should reuse rollout diff payload; added TODO for payload field mapping.
Research (Lina V.): Prototype test showed users skimmed cost numbers; bumped font-weight and added an affordance to open a detailed cost popover.
Security (Renee H.): Request to include audit-event hint text (we added a small 'actions are audited' note in the dialog footer).
qa_findings: Overlay close button hit target at 320px is < 44px — increased padding and re-tested (verified on iPhone SE emulator).
Screenreader reading order for diff rows was incorrect — changed to table semantics and added aria-live region for dynamic cost updates.
Contrast ratio for delta chips at small sizes was 3.8:1 — selected a darker token color to reach 4.5:1.
Edge case: when rollout has zero-cost delta, system still showed +0.00; changed to 'No change' microcopy per PM request.
next_steps: Address ENG PR comments on CSS variables and token alignment (assigned to Diego).
Finalize accessibility notes in the handoff doc and attach to the PR.
Schedule 30m cross-functional review (design + eng + QA) for 2026-02-20 to approve final assets and test plan.
Prepare a short recording of prototype flows for the release notes and onboarding doc.
